customer_text: My Kindle Paperwhite won't connect to my home Wi-Fi after updating the password.
clean_text: My Kindle Paperwhite won't connect to my home Wi-Fi after updating the password.
conversation_context: CUSTOMER: My Kindle Paperwhite won't connect to my home Wi-Fi after updating the password.
support_response: Let's help! Go to Settings > Wi-Fi Networks, tap your network and select 'Forget'. Then restart your Kindle and enter your new password. ^MN
